decisions.reason: The DPA management software draws on the firm's documented compliance know-how and agency focus, customers have given positive feedback on its templates, and it fits the stated direction of expanding compliance capabilities.
As the flagship management platform on the home page, it builds directly on the firm's integrated management tools and containerized infrastructure and is central to its agency-platform strategy.
The configurable managed hosting plan is a natural extension of the core hosting business on owned infrastructure, so the firm can read its results well and refine it.

Extended PHP security support builds on the firm's specialized technical teams and security know-how and meets ongoing agency demand for legacy versions, though as a minor add-on it may later be folded into other offerings.
